text: Epictetus is not superior to Socrates; but if he is not inferior, this is enough for me; for I shall never be a Milo, and yet I do not neglect my body... nor, in a word, do we neglect looking after anything because we despair of reaching the highest degree.
author: Epictetus
locator: Discourses, How a Man on Every Occasion Can Maintain His Proper Character
